info.title: uilab-session
info.summary: Holds the open document, the selection and every proposal made against it.
info.description:
The HTTP surface of `uilab-session`, one of the components of `uilab` v1.

Every path here is one semantic command, so the method is always POST and the path is the command's wire name under its domain's: a command is not a resource, and this document does not invent one. A status code is the outcome the specification declares — 202 for a branch that was taken, 422 for a refusal the input decides, 502 for a refusal decided outside the request — and the `outcome` property of every response body names the branch. Events emitted by a branch are published to consumers through the event transport, and the `published` property of every response body lists them too, in publication order.

This component declares `reached_by: network`, so its callers are not deployed with it and this contract is the surface they reach it through. That declaration is also why the views its domains declare have paths here: a GET under `views` per projection, answering every row it holds. There is no page size, no cursor, no ordering and no filter parameter, because the specification states none — a view's filter is part of the projection, not of the request.

tags.name: session
tags.description: One open UI document, the node the operator has selected in it, and the patches an agent proposes there. A patch changes the document only when the operator accepts it.

202.description: Outcome `accepted`: the branch the specification declares for this input. Events this branch emits are published to consumers and listed under `published`.

409.description: Outcome `wrong-state`: the input was acceptable and the subject is in a state this command does not act from. Resending the same request changes nothing until something else moves it.

501.description: No declared outcome: the realization is unfinished. Either a port this command runs reported an unmet obligation, and nothing was written: `committed` is `false`. Or the command's effect was committed and delivering what this command published to a binding failed: `committed` is `true`, the effect and its events stand, and each binding whose delivery failed keeps its event and is attempted again on a later delivery, while no other binding receives it twice. Do not retry: after a failed delivery a retry performs the command a second time.

committed.description: `true` when the command's effect and events were committed and delivering what it published failed; `false` when an unmet obligation stopped the command before anything was written.

refused.description: What was left unfinished, in words.

502.description: Outcome `stale`: something outside the request refused. The input was acceptable, so the caller has nothing to correct and a retry is meaningful.

200.description: Every row of `uilab.session.Documents`, a projection of `uilab.session.Document`. Contains every instance. Read-your-writes: a caller that has just issued a command sees its effect here.

Every row of `uilab.session.Pending`, a projection of `uilab.session.Proposal`. Contains the instances where `state == Proposed` holds. Read-your-writes: a caller that has just issued a command sees its effect here.
Every row of `uilab.session.Proposals`, a projection of `uilab.session.Proposal`. Contains every instance. Read-your-writes: a caller that has just issued a command sees its effect here.

uilab.session.AcceptProposal.accepted.Re.description: The patch is applied and the document is saved. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `uilab.session.Proposal` has moved to `Accepted`, along `accept`. The instance is the one `proposal_id` names. Emits `ProposalAccepted`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.AcceptProposal.stale.Respo.description: The proposal stays waiting and the document is unchanged. Decided outside the request: the document changed since the proposal and the patch no longer applies.

error.description: The patch fails a document check, so no proposal was made.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.AcceptProposal.wrong-state.description: The proposal is not waiting, so the document is unchanged. Taken when the subject is in a state none of this command's declared moves start from. Which states those are is the lifecycle's answer, not this command's. For an instance no record carries, `payload` is absent, because an instance that does not exist has nothing for the error to describe.

error.description: The proposal is not in a state this command acts from, so nothing moved.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.NodeNotFound.Error.description: No node of the document has this path, so the selection did not change.

uilab.session.OpenDocument.opened.Respon.description: The document is open with its root selected. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `uilab.session.Document` now exists, in `Open`. Its identity is published as `document_id` on `uilab.session.DocumentOpened`. Emits `DocumentOpened`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

error.description: The file is not an ess-ui/1 document, so nothing was opened.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.ProposalStateConflict.Erro.description: The proposal is not in a state this command acts from, so nothing moved.

uilab.session.ProposePatch.proposed.Resp.description: The patch passes every document check and waits for the operator. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `uilab.session.Proposal` now exists, in `Proposed`. Its identity is published as `proposal_id` on `uilab.session.PatchProposed`. Emits `PatchProposed`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.ProposePatch.refused.Respo.description: No proposal was made and the document is unchanged. Decided outside the request: the patched document fails a document check.

error.description: The patch fails a document check, so no proposal was made.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.RejectProposal.rejected.Re.description: The patch is dropped and the document is unchanged. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `uilab.session.Proposal` has moved to `Rejected`, along `reject`. The instance is the one `proposal_id` names. Emits `ProposalRejected`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.RejectProposal.wrong-state.description: The proposal is not waiting, so nothing was rejected. Taken when the subject is in a state none of this command's declared moves start from. Which states those are is the lifecycle's answer, not this command's. For an instance no record carries, `payload` is absent, because an instance that does not exist has nothing for the error to describe.

error.description: The proposal is not in a state this command acts from, so nothing moved.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

uilab.session.SelectNode.selected.Respon.description: The node at the path is selected; proposals are made there. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `uilab.session.Document` has changed, and its state is unchanged. The instance is the one `document_id` names. Emits `NodeSelected`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

uilab.session.UndoProposal.undone.Respon.description: The document is back to what it was before the patch, and saved. Taken when no other outcome's condition matched. A `uilab.session.Proposal` has moved to `Undone`, along `undo`. The instance is the one `proposal_id` names. Emits `ProposalUndone`, published to consumers and listed under `published`.

outcome.description: Which declared outcome the command took.

published.description: Every event this branch published, in publication order: its qualified name and its payload.
